title: Lead & Call Tracking Software Pricing - WhatConverts

facts.fact: According to the page, the wc_visitor cookie lasts 1 year 1 month 4 days and identifies a unique visitor so lead activity can be attributed to the correct visit.
facts.quote: Identifies a unique visitor to the website so lead activity can be accurately associated with the correct visit

facts.fact: According to the page, the wc_client cookie lasts 6 months and is set by the provider Woundwo.com to record the landing page and source of a visitor's visit.
facts.quote: This cookie is set by the provider Woundwo.com. This cookie is used for identifying the web traffic.

facts.fact: According to the page, the wc_client_current cookie is a session cookie that stores temporary visitor session information used to maintain attribution data.
facts.quote: Stores temporary visitor session information used by WhatConverts to maintain attribution data

facts.fact: According to the page, the pscd cookie lasts 3 months and supports core website functionality, visitor attribution, and session continuity.
facts.quote: Stores information required to support core website functionality, visitor attribution, and session continuity.

facts.fact: According to the page, the Cloudflare __cf_bm cookie lasts 1 hour and supports Cloudflare Bot Management.
facts.quote: This cookie, set by Cloudflare, is used to support Cloudflare Bot Management.

facts.fact: According to the page, the __stripe_mid cookie set by Stripe lasts 1 year and recognizes users across sessions.
facts.quote: Stripe sets this cookie to set a unique session identifier to recognize users across sessions.

facts.fact: According to the page, the ajs_group_id cookie set by Segment lasts 1 year and tracks visitor usage and events on the website.
facts.quote: This cookie is set by Segment to track visitor usage and events within the website.

facts.fact: According to the page, the first_visit_date analytics cookie never expires and records the date of a visitor's first visit.
facts.quote: Records the date of a visitor's first visit to help distinguish new and returning visitors

facts.fact: According to the page, the _calendly_session cookie lasts 21 days and lets the Calendly meeting scheduler function on the website.
facts.quote: Calendly, a Meeting Schedulers, sets this cookie to allow the meeting scheduler to function within the website
